text: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a Teams invite.
Be the change request you wish to see in the world.
Silence is golden. Mute is platinum.
Inhale confidence. Exhale an action log.
Dance like nobody's watching. Deploy like everybody is.
Your only limit is DA.
Stillness is just motion with its camera off.
If at first you don't succeed, raise it at the retro.
Believe in yourself. Nobody else has capacity this sprint.
Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a mystery. Today is a working day, allegedly.
The mountain does not rush. Neither does Governance.
Find your inner peace. It's probably on Sharepoint, in a folder called Final_v3_final.
A goal without a plan is just a wish. A plan without a goal is a Jira epic.
Let go of what you cannot control. Such as the pod restart count.
Not all who wander are lost. Some are looking for the Teams link.
Every cloud has a silver lining. Except AWS, which has a bill.
Breathe in. Breathe out. Log this as learning and development hours.
Be like water. Find the lowest point and stay there until someone escalates.
Every expert was once a beginner who also didn't read the documentation.
The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is after the business case is approved.
Your vibe attracts your tribe. Your calendar attracts recurring meetings.
Don't count the days. Make the days count. Then put them in a spreadsheet.
Silence speaks louder than words. Especially when someone asks for volunteers.
Happiness is not a destination. It is a Friday afternoon with nothing broken in production.
The tree that bends in the storm survives. The tree that raises a ticket is still waiting.
The wise owl says nothing. That is why nobody assigns it actions.
Rome wasn't built in a day. It also didn't have a sprint goal.
Clear your mind. Clear your cache. Try again.
The only constant is change. And the forms you fill in about it.
Reach for the stars. If you miss, you'll land in a steering group.
Peace comes from within. Do not seek it in the incident channels.
Where focus goes, energy flows. Where energy flows, someone books a meeting about it.
The early bird gets the worm. The second mouse gets the cheese. The third person asks 'can everyone see my screen?'
A journey is measured not in miles, but in how many times you said 'sorry, you go.'
Be present. Or at least appear green in Teams.
